summary: Extends vCard so an address-book entry can hold an instant messaging or presence address as a URI. As IM grows, people want to save those contacts alongside phone numbers and email. It was replaced by RFC 6350.

eli5.summary: An address book has spots for phone and email. This adds a spot for chat names too. It was later replaced by a newer version of vCard.

questions: how to store im address in vcard
